items.desc: Eglo Records' main man Alexander Nut joins us for some slick late night futurism. Broken beat, soul, and whatever else happens to take his fancy. From the host: "A live recording of Alex Nut b2b Mr Scruff, taken from last Sundays final Eglo Records session at Corsica Studios, ahead of the club closing in March. Corsica Studios has been the labels late night London home for the last 10 years, so we had to have a proper send. The recording is a 2 hour segments of what was an special 6 hour back to back set from label boss Alex Nut and our good friend Mr Scruff."
